This repository (**MapMet2**) provides the `R`-based single-cell analysis of
neuroblastoma bone-marrow samples (control BM, and patient BM at diagnosis, the
treatment timepoints T1 / T2 and relapse) imaged by imaging mass cytometry. It
is adapted from [MapMetSC](https://github.com/TaschnerMandlGroup/MapMetSC), the
single-cell workflow of Lazic et al. for primary and metastatic neuroblastoma,
and builds on data processed with the `python`-based image-processing pipeline
[MapMetIP](https://github.com/TaschnerMandlGroup/MapMetIP).

See the [Home](index.html) page for the ordered list of analysis steps, and the
repository `README` and `run_analysis.R` for setup and reproduction instructions.
